title: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to a…
description: IBM Engineering AI Hub versions 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 contain a Cross Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) misconfiguration that could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating a medium severity level. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
